department: Yale School of the Environment (Environment PhD)

deadline.value: January 2 (year inferred from the 2026-27 cycle); combined-degree applicants face the earlier of the two programs' deadlines or December 15.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is optional; check the program website.
gre_general.quote: GRE is optional. Please check the program website for more information.

supervisor.value: You must identify and contact one or two faculty who could be your major advisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: All applicants must identify and contact one or two faculty members who they think could serve as their major advisor.

funding.value: The doctoral program is fully funded.
funding.quote: and what’s more, it is fully funded.

also.quote: Every PhD student receives a funding package that covers the full cost of tuition and provides a stipend to cover basic living costs like rent, food, and books — for a minimum of five years.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required to apply for a Yale PhD, so you can apply straight from a bachelor's (some programs prefer extra training).
entry_route.quote: A Master's degree is not required to apply for a PhD at Yale, although some programs give preference to applicants with post-baccalaureate training.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE listed for this field on the pages checked.

notes: Applications go through GSAS but the program is run by the Yale School of the Environment.
